profile.name: Mayank Chauhan
roles: Senior Visual Designer | Senior Graphic Designer
profile.intro: I build clear, polished visual systems for campaigns, brand communication, presentations, and multi-format marketing delivery.
profile.positioning: Senior-level visual execution across real-estate marketing, brand campaigns, presentations, digital creatives, and print production - with a focus on ownership, stakeholder collaboration, quality control, and consistent delivery across formats.
profile.aboutHeading: Commercial visual design built for campaigns, stakeholders, and real-world delivery.
profile.aboutSnapshot: From brief to consistent multi-format execution.
profile.aboutSnapshotBody: I translate marketing and sales requirements into clear visual systems, manage revisions, maintain production quality, and prepare assets for digital, print, presentation, and video use.
aboutParagraphs: I am a Senior Visual Designer and Senior Graphic Designer focused on commercial brand communication, campaign systems, presentations, marketing creatives, and real-estate visual execution.
My work combines clear hierarchy, disciplined typography, strong image treatment, stakeholder collaboration, and production-ready delivery across digital, print, presentation, and motion formats.
AI-assisted tools support selected concept and production tasks; design judgment, brand consistency, and commercial execution remain at the centre of the work.
